<div class="card-body">
'''We Have A Prisoner''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">捕虜を捕らえました</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：敵がキャラクターを戦闘によってロストするか没収した際に使用する。1フォース消費する。キャラクターはロストするかわりに捕虜になる。2：Xフォース消費して、捕まっている宇宙船上のすべてのキャラクターを捕虜にする。X＝キャラクターの人数の2倍である。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-We-Have-A-Prisoner-PSA-90960103.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「貴方は反乱同盟の一党で反逆者だ。連行しろ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' We Have A Prisoner.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use when the opponent loses or forfeits a character from battle. Spend 1 Force. The character becomes a captive instead of being lost.

2: Spend X Force to make all characters on a captured starship captives. X is twice the number of characters.

'''Lore:'''
You are a member of the Rebel Alliance and a traitor. Take this person away!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[We Have A Prisoner]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
